notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
